notablePrerequisites: Forensic Researcher and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Forensic Researcher triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Kiora's Follower triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
